rows.definition: The ctxplan.AssumptionSource value marking a planning assumption as backed by independently witnessed evidence rather than user statement, inference, or staleness.
rows.distinction: An assumption-provenance label inside ctxplan; it neither records a world-state witness nor grades a completion claim.

rows.definition: The debtlane lane Related field listing the benchmark-authority mentions that witness a debt lane's benchmark claims.
rows.distinction: A mention list attached to a debt lane; it is not a benchmark run, a WitnessRecord evidence type, or a witness outcome.

rows.definition: The unexported vdso helper that derives the external world-state witness string for a file or directory tool call from its arguments.
rows.distinction: Produces the witness string for a file call; it does not resolve or corroborate claims, which is the WitnessResolver's job.

rows.definition: The stopgate Disposition returned when a completion claim lacks a verified receipt but the gate refuses to end the run, continuing to demand the witness.
rows.distinction: Keeps the loop alive after an unwitnessed claim; contrasts with DispClaimUnwitnessedGiveUp, which terminates, and DispClaimWitnessed, which accepts.

rows.definition: The stopgate Disposition terminating a run whose completion claim stays unwitnessed past the gate's continuation budget.
rows.distinction: Ends the run on persistent unwitnessed claims; contrasts with DispClaimUnwitnessedContinue, which still demands the witness, and DispClaimWitnessed, which accepts a verified one.

rows.definition: The stopgate Disposition accepting a completion claim because its receipt verified as witnessed.
rows.distinction: Accepts a verified claim; contrasts with the two unwitnessed dispositions that reject or defer it.

rows.definition: The observer sentinel error returned when a mutating step's claimed effect has no confirmed diff witness.
rows.distinction: A Go error value signaling the failure; the closed-vocabulary verdict recording the same state is WitnessUnwitnessedClaim.

rows.definition: The physical-execution witness string a roofline receipt must carry whenever it claims Simulated=false, naming the device or kernel evidence that the run actually executed on hardware.
rows.distinction: A receipt field gating physical versus simulated claims; it is not a world-state binding and not a self-reported claim.

rows.definition: The grandfathered Python tool tools/glm_witness_record.py that records GLM model witnesses, kept in the branch-role ref audit and mapped to platform/cluster/glm_witness.go by the factory migration.
rows.distinction: A legacy script artifact named in inventories; it is not the WitnessRecord evidence type and not a live witness resolver.

rows.definition: The pre-push hook gate (fak hooks import-witness) that flags committed .go files importing module-local packages with zero tracked files at the witnessed revision, i.e. a forgotten git add of a whole package.
rows.distinction: A cheap structural tree-level build witness reading only the committed tree; it is not the heavy compile-integrity pre-push build gate and archives nothing.

rows.definition: The abi refusal reason (wire INTEGRITY_REFUTED) raised when the witness resolver actively refutes a claimed effect, so the produced proof contradicts the claim instead of being merely absent.
rows.distinction: Positive contradiction of a claim; contrasts with UNWITNESSED, where no usable proof exists at all.

rows.definition: The goal-runner launch witness string recorded on a goal launch result, e.g. the PLAN_ONLY marker proving which mode the runner actually entered.
rows.distinction: Launch-time provenance for a goal run; it is not a completion or stop-gate witness and carries no refusal reason.

rows.definition: The witness-instrumented Vulkan compute static library linked into internal/compute when the v41_indexer_witness build tag selects the V4.1 indexer witness variant instead of plain libfakvulkan.
rows.distinction: The link-time library artifact itself; the build tag that selects it, v41_indexer_witness, is a different concept.

rows.definition: The issue-policy closure-gate reason (wire ISSUE_CLOSURE_WITNESS_MISSING) emitted when a ship or close request names no independently witnessed completion standard, or the witness grade falls below strong.
rows.distinction: The witness is absent or too weak; contrasts with ReasonClosureWitnessMismatch, where a witnessed standard exists but differs from the claimed one.

rows.definition: The issue-policy closure-gate reason (wire ISSUE_CLOSURE_WITNESS_MISMATCH) emitted when the closure's claimed completion standard differs from the independently witnessed standard.
rows.distinction: The witness exists but disagrees with the claim; contrasts with ReasonClosureWitnessMissing, where no adequate witness standard is named at all.

rows.definition: The gateway stop-gate refusal reason (code 1070, wire STOP_UNWITNESSED, outside the frozen core reason range) raised when a turn wants to stop without a verified terminal receipt.
rows.distinction: The refusal reason that fires; the stopgate dispositions (DispClaimUnwitnessedContinue/GiveUp) are what the boundary decides afterwards.

rows.definition: The loop-recovery result counter of runs found in the ledger with no completion witness, recovered alongside orphaned runs by fak loop recover.
rows.distinction: A recovery-ledger counter over runs; it is not a refusal reason, a verdict, or the conceptbench claim-unwitnessed episode count.

rows.definition: The test-only atomic.Bool switch in the V4.1 BF16 publication path that turns on host-round and device-publication counters so a test can witness where each round was computed.
rows.distinction: An instrumentation switch read by production hot paths only while a test holds it on; it is not a published witness artifact nor a build-tag witness variant.

rows.definition: The Go build tag that makes internal/compute link the witness-instrumented V4.1 indexer Vulkan static library instead of the plain libfakvulkan.
rows.distinction: The build tag selecting the witness variant; the library it links, lfakvulkan_v41_indexer_witness, is the separate artifact.

rows.definition: The cachemeta entry option that attaches an external world-state witness string, e.g. git:c0ffee, to a cache metadata entry.
rows.distinction: Attaches a witness to cache metadata; it does not create or verify the witness, unlike deriveFileWitness or the WitnessResolver.

rows.definition: The observer mutation-evidence verdict stating that a mutating step's claimed effect came back unwitnessed by the diff screen.
rows.distinction: A closed-vocabulary verdict value; the sentinel error reporting the same state is ErrUnwitnessedDiff, and the positive counterpart is WITNESS_DIFF_CONFIRMED.

rows.definition: The observer closed-vocabulary type for mutation-evidence verification verdicts, whose members are WITNESS_DIFF_CONFIRMED and WITNESS_UNWITNESSED_CLAIM.
rows.distinction: The verdict type over mutation evidence; it is not the abi kernel Verdict and not either of its member values.
